title: A lane that merged stops cleanly (S21)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S21 (Sector 6 — Harness and delivery (ADR 0022)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0022 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
